name: Text
summary: Body copy, captions, paragraphs and in-page headings on the DS type scale: sizes, weights 400/600, the four text greys, one-line ellipsis and multi-line clamp.
highlights: One element for text, paragraphs and section headings (antd Title, Text and Paragraph)
One-line ellipsis or a multi-line clamp, full text in the tooltip when cut
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-text> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. It replaces antd Typography (Title, Text, Paragraph) with values taken only from the type tokens: `size` picks a step of the scale (12 · 14 · 16 · 18 · 20 · 24 · 32), `weight` is regular 400 or semibold 600, and `tone` is one of the text greys (default #1A1A1A, secondary #4A4A4A, tertiary #8A8A8A, disabled #B5B5B5) or inverse white. `level` makes it a section heading (role heading with aria-level, SemiBold, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing 0) sized from the level unless `size` overrides it; `as="p"` makes a block paragraph. `ellipsis` cuts one line with an ellipsis and `lines` clamps to N lines; when the text is actually cut the host gets the full text as its title. There is no status hue, so danger, success and warning text is the default ink paired with an icon or words. The page title is not this element: it is <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title">. Text is a static marker with no interactive state, so it carries no motion.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. Attributes only. React 18 sets every prop on a custom element as a string attribute, so pass `ellipsis` only when it is on (`ellipsis={cut || undefined}`); `ellipsis="false"` is treated as off. No margins: space text with <aha-space>, <aha-flex> or the layout gap.

spec.label: Body (default)
spec.value: Plus Jakarta Regular 400, 14/1.5, letter-spacing 0.2px, text-default #1A1A1A, inline

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: size sm 12 (ls 0.3px) · default 14 · l 16 at line-height 1.5; h6 18 · xl 20 · h4 24 · h3 32 at line-height 1.3

spec.label: Tones
spec.value: default #1A1A1A · secondary #4A4A4A · tertiary #8A8A8A · disabled #B5B5B5 · inverse #FFFFFF (dark surfaces) · inherit; no status hue

spec.label: Heading (level)
spec.value: role heading + aria-level; SemiBold 600, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing 0, block. Size by level: 1 → 32 · 2 → 24 · 3 → 20 · 4 → 18 · 5 → 16 · 6 → 14; `size` overrides

spec.label: Ellipsis
spec.value: `ellipsis` → one line, cut with …; `lines="N"` → clamp to N lines; full text as the host title when cut, unless the author set a title

spec.label: Margins
spec.value: none; layout spacing comes from the container gap

props.name: size
props.type: sm | default | l | h6 | xl | h4 | h3
props.desc: Step of the type scale: 12 · 14 · 16 · 18 · 20 · 24 · 32. Overrides the size a level gives

props.name: weight
props.desc: 400 or 600, the only product weights. Replaces antd `strong`

props.name: tone
props.type: default | secondary | tertiary | disabled | inverse | inherit
props.desc: Text grey from the colour rules. antd type="secondary" → secondary; type="danger" / "success" / "warning" → default (no status hue; pair with an icon or words)

props.name: level
props.desc: Makes the text a section heading (role heading, aria-level), SemiBold, sized 32 / 24 / 20 / 18 / 16 / 14. Replaces antd Title. Not the page title: use <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title">

props.name: as
props.desc: p draws a block paragraph (antd Paragraph), span flows inline (antd Text)

props.name: ellipsis
props.desc: Cut to one line with an ellipsis; the full text becomes the host title when it is cut

props.name: lines
props.desc: Clamp to this many lines with an ellipsis (antd ellipsis={{ rows: N }})

whenToUse.when: any visible copy that is not a control's own label: body copy, captions, metadata, helper lines, card and section headings
a heading inside a page: a section, card, panel or empty-state title
the page's own title: never <aha-text level="1">
a section heading with its description and actions in one row
a link in or beside text (antd Typography.Link): <aha-button variant="text-link" href>

opinion.note: Never set font-size, font-weight or colour on text by hand: pick size, weight and tone. Status is never a colour: a failed or warning line is default ink with a status icon or words. Typography.Link is a link, so it is a Button (text-link) with href, not text.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the DS type scale as one element: Plus Jakarta Sans, sizes 12-32 from the size tokens, weights 400/600, the text greys and the letter-spacing ratios (headings 0, body 0.2, subtext 0.3). Built to replace antd Typography in React apps (Title level → level, Text type → tone, strong → weight, Paragraph → as=p, ellipsis → ellipsis / lines). antd's copyable, editable, code, mark, italic, underline and delete have no DS role and are not offered.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: tones are text greys; no status hue
ellipsis one line, lines clamps, title only when cut

a11y.role: none for body text (slotted text stays in the light DOM); `level` adds role="heading" with aria-level unless the author set a role
a11y.note: `level`, `ellipsis`, `lines` and `title` re-sync on change (observed attributes). Contrast on white: default 17.4:1 and secondary 8.9:1 pass AA at every size; tertiary is 3.45:1, so it passes only as large text (24px, or 19px semibold) and is otherwise for non-essential metadata; disabled (2.05:1) is exempt as inactive text. Body copy is default or secondary.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe is a level-2 secondary heading; the clamp probe a two-line clamp.
